title: 06. 간식은 조금만, 밥이 든든!
titleT: 06. Just a Little Snack, a Hearty Meal!

pages.ko: 호리네 집에 놀러 온 콩이는 간식 바구니를 보자 눈이 왕방울만 해졌어요. "우와, 과자다!" 엄마가 접시에 과자를 한 접시 예쁘게 담아 줬어요. "요건 간식이야. 조금만 먹자." 콩이는 벌써 침이 꼴깍 넘어가요.
pages.t: Kongi, who came to play at Hori's house, saw the snack basket and her eyes went as round as saucers. "Wow, cookies!" Mom neatly arranged a plate of cookies for her. "This is a snack. Let's just eat a little bit." Kongi's mouth was already watering.

pages.ko: 한 접시를 뚝딱 비운 콩이는 참을 수가 없었어요. 엄마가 잠깐 부엌에 간 사이, 간식 바구니를 슬그머니 열고 과자를 와구와구! "조금만 더, 조금만 더…" 어느새 바구니가 텅— 비었어요.
pages.t: Kongi polished off the whole plate in no time and just couldn't hold back. While Mom stepped into the kitchen for a moment, Kongi quietly opened the snack basket and munched away, gobble gobble! "Just a little more, just a little more..." Before she knew it, the basket was completely empty.

pages.ko: 저녁이 되자 맛있는 밥이 차려졌어요. 그런데 콩이는 배가 빵빵하고 살살 아파요. "우웅, 배불러… 밥은 못 먹겠어." 좋아하는 밥을 앞에 두고도 한 입도 못 먹은 콩이는 시무룩 고개를 숙였어요.
pages.t: When evening came, a delicious dinner was laid out. But Kongi's tummy was round and full, and it ached a little. "Ohh, I'm so full... I can't eat dinner." Even with her favorite meal right in front of her, Kongi couldn't take a single bite and hung her head sadly.

pages.ko: 엄마가 콩이 옆에 앉아 배를 살살 문질러 줬어요. "간식을 너무 많이 먹어서 배가 밥 먹을 자리가 없어졌구나." 콩이 눈에 눈물이 그렁그렁. "밥 먹고 싶은데…" 엄마가 콩이 손을 꼭 잡아요. "괜찮아. 다음엔 조금만 먹는 법을 알려 줄게."
pages.t: Mom sat beside Kongi and gently rubbed her tummy. "You ate so many snacks that your tummy has no room left for dinner." Tears welled up in Kongi's eyes. "But I want to eat dinner..." Mom took Kongi's hand and held it tight. "It's okay. Next time, I'll teach you how to eat just a little."

pages.ko: 엄마가 재미난 이야기를 해 줬어요. "뱃속은 작은 방이야. 간식으로 방을 꽉 채우면, 밥이 들어올 자리가 없단다." 콩이 눈앞에 그림이 그려졌어요. 작은 배 방에 과자가 잔뜩 쌓여, 밥 친구가 문 앞에서 못 들어가고 발을 동동! "아하, 그래서 자리를 남겨 둬야 하는구나!"
pages.t: Mom told her a fun little story. "Your tummy is like a tiny room. If you fill the whole room with snacks, there's no space left for dinner to come in." A picture formed in Kongi's mind: her tiny tummy room stuffed full of cookies, while her dinner friend stood stuck at the door, hopping in place! "Ahh, that's why I have to save some room!"

pages.ko: "밥이 들어올 자리는 요만큼 꼭 남겨 두는 거야." 엄마가 손가락으로 조그맣게 '요만큼'을 만들어 보였어요. "간식은 한 접시만, 정한 시간에만!" 호리도 옆에서 거들어요. "나랑 같이 약속하자!" 콩이 눈이 반짝 빛났어요.
pages.t: "You always leave just this much room for dinner." Mom held up her fingers to show a tiny 'this much.' "Only one plate of snacks, and only at snack time!" Hori chimed in too. "Let's make the promise together!" Kongi's eyes sparkled.

pages.ko: 다음 날 오후, 간식 시간이 됐어요. 엄마가 과자를 한 접시 담아 주자, 콩이는 요만큼만 먹고 접시를 딱 내려놓았어요. 바구니는 안 열었어요! "간식은 요만큼, 밥이 먼저!" 참는 게 처음엔 힘들었지만, 콩이는 해냈어요.
pages.t: The next afternoon, it was snack time again. When Mom gave her a plate of cookies, Kongi ate just this much and set the plate down firmly. She didn't open the basket! "Just a little snack, dinner comes first!" Holding back was hard at first, but Kongi did it.

pages.ko: 저녁이 되자 배가 살짝 꼬르륵! 콩이는 밥을 냠냠 아주 맛있게 먹었어요. "우와, 밥이 이렇게 맛있었어?" 배도 편안, 마음도 뿌듯! 그 순간 콩이 복슬 꼬리 둘레가 반짝반짝, 콩이가 폴짝 뛰었어요. 해냈어요!
pages.t: When evening came, her tummy gave a little rumble! Kongi ate her dinner happily, nom nom, savoring every bite. "Wow, was dinner always this delicious?" Her tummy felt comfortable, and her heart felt proud! At that moment, the fur around Kongi's fluffy tail sparkled bright, and she hopped for joy. She did it!

pages.ko: 이제 콩이는 규칙을 알아요. 하나, 간식은 한 접시만! 둘, 밥이 먼저, 간식은 나중! 셋, 정한 시간에만 냠냠! 다음에도 콩이는 간식을 요만큼만 먹고 접시를 딱 내려놔요. 간식은 요만큼, 밥이 먼저!
pages.t: Now Kongi knows the rules. One, only one plate of snacks! Two, dinner comes first, snacks come later! Three, nom nom only at snack time! From then on, Kongi eats just this much snack and firmly sets the plate down. Just a little snack, dinner comes first!

pages.ko: 엄마가 콩이를 꼭 안아 주었어요. "우리 콩이, 이제 참을 줄도 아는 멋진 어린이네!" 이제 콩이는 알아요. 간식은 조금만, 밥이 먼저 먹으면 배도 편하고 밥도 더 맛있다는 걸. 간식은 요만큼, 밥이 먼저!
pages.t: Mom gave Kongi a big hug. "My Kongi, you're such a wonderful girl for learning to hold back!" Now Kongi knows that eating just a little snack and letting dinner come first makes her tummy comfortable and her dinner even tastier. Just a little snack, dinner comes first!

overview.ko: 간식을 너무 많이 먹어 밥을 거르고 배탈이 난 호리가 '조금만' 먹는 법을 배우는 식습관 동화입니다.
overview.t: An eating-habits story about Kongi, who ate too many snacks, skipped dinner, and got a tummy ache, learning to eat 'just a little' instead.

lessons.t: Understand the importance of regular mealtimes.

readingTips.t: Read the 'just a little, Kongi' refrain together in a cheerful voice.

readingTips.ko: 간식 시간에 양을 함께 정해 보세요.
readingTips.t: Try deciding on a snack portion together before snack time.
